title: Das Kirchenbuch zu Gröben (1578-1769)
notes: Transcription, spread by spread (two pages per web page, with facsimile), of the church register begun in 1578: baptisms, marriages, burials, plus some inserted documents such as a letter of Melanchthon. The site covers 1578-1769; the part dated 1578-1700 is 248 page spreads (pages 1 to c. 505). The site footer reads © 2009 EKBO and its news feed was last updated on 18 March 2014, so it is listed as archived. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
license_note: No licence on the site (footer '© 2009 EKBO', Impressum, Hilfe page) or in its pages; the Impressum names the Gemeindekirchenrat Gröben as publisher and credits the page photographs to the Evangelisches Zentralarchiv Berlin (checked 2026-10-13).
